mode.description: What the block shows. In code mode it shows source. In diff mode it shows a line diff from before to after. A mode takes only its own inputs: code mode takes source and not before or after, and diff mode takes before and after and not source.

source.description: The code to show, in code mode. It is required there and not allowed with before or after. At most 1,000,000 UTF-16 units and 10,000 lines.

before.description: The original code, in diff mode. It is required there with after, and not allowed with source. At most 1,000,000 UTF-16 units and 10,000 lines.

after.description: The updated code, in diff mode. It is required there with before, and not allowed with source. The copy action copies it. At most 1,000,000 UTF-16 units and 10,000 lines.

language.description: A Shiki language name or alias. It colours the code once the highlighter loads, and labels the header when filename is absent. A missing or unsupported language stays plain text.

filename.description: Labels the listing in the header.

lineNumbers.description: Whether line numbers show. A diff shows original and updated positions.

copyable.description: Whether the copy action shows. It copies the exact source, or in diff mode the exact after.

wrap.description: Whether long lines wrap. When false, they scroll horizontally.
